scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @ft/server" "npm run dev -w @ft/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @ft/server && npm run build -w @ft/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ft/server && npm run typecheck -w @ft/web
